protocol.dataset: MASiVar (OpenNeuro ds003416, CC0), cohort III, scanner B: Philips Achieva 3T (Cai et al., MRM 2021)

b0s.forward: 16 (interleaved, stated b = 0.1; each series' last volume, stated b = 0, is a real b0 at 0.98-1.0 of the others and kept)
b0s.reversed: 1 (the APA series, named b1000 n3: its last volume, 0.89-0.95 of the forward b0s; its three b1000s, 0.38-0.45, dropped)

protocol.readout: not in the sidecars: nominal 0.05 s (_masivar.NOMINAL_READOUT_S); the field in Hz is on a nominal scale, safe within this protocol

recognized by.checked by: calibration_runs.load_checked (protocol_check), on the scan as _masivar loads it

pipeline.ensemble: A and 16 bootstrap replicates (smooth signs, FWHM 4, b0s added), labeler draw 0

validity.pipeline: these settings and R only; any option that changes the pipeline (denoising, tracker settings, labeler grouping) needs its own card

events.same session: a rescan in the same session, minutes later (MASiVar scan 2)
events.other session: a rescan in another session (a separate visit) on the same scanner; the interval between sessions was not checked

validity.outside: without a matching card the product says "run-to-run only"
validity.not covered: accuracy (what the anatomy is): see accuracy (provisional)

streamline.statement: P(a rescan's streamline from this seed gets the ensemble's mode tract), stated as the mode's share of the R runs
streamline.use: diagnostic only: the data product never presents a single streamline's name as a finding

point.statement: P(a rescan's main named tract within 8 mm of the point is the ensemble's mode), stated as the mode's share

envelope.presence: density >= 0.3 per mm^2 (ensemble_grid_check), the 42 named tracts pooled, weighted by the rescan's voxels

accuracy (provisional).how to read: not applied to any statement. Its gaps are between the pipeline's envelopes and a bias-free ensemble at the same uncalibrated stated levels (0.8-0.95), not at the card's levels; it must not be added to or stacked on the card's maps, which are about rescans
accuracy (provisional).status: provisional and protocol-mismatched: one simulated brain (ISMRM 2015, Fiberfox), b = 1000 with 32 directions (this card's protocol: b1000 x40 + b2000 x56, tracked at 2000), its own readout and noise (DW SNR about 7.6)
accuracy (provisional).event: the ground truth's own density presence (count-matched to each run's streamlines), not a rescan
accuracy (provisional).reading: the envelopes state reproducibility, not accuracy: on the phantom they cover 17-18 points less of the truth than a bias-free ensemble does at stated 0.8-0.95 (the gaps above). A statement about the anatomy needs this bias term; without it the card's statements are about rescans only
